notesDetails.title: Manual Note vs. Session Log Audit: 33m 46s Wall-Clock (34m), 7 Agent Commits (vs. 'Git commit: 6' Note Header) & 39/39 Tests in 113.0s
bullets: Exact Duration Match (`33m 46s` in Note vs. `33m 46.2s` JSONL Span / `34m`): `records/20261119T041015Z.events.jsonl` opened at `2026-11-19T04:10:15Z` (`11:10:15.38 WIB`) and wrote its final event at `11:44:01.54 WIB` (`2,026.16s` = `33m 46.2s`, matching the manual note's `TIme 33m46s` to the second; `result.duration_seconds: 2023.308s` = `33m 43.3s`), rounding to **`34m`**.

Commit Count Discrepancy (`7` Agent Commits vs. `Git commit: 6` Header): Although the manual note header read `Git commit: 6`, the 8-line `git log` immediately beneath it contains pre-run `be29e0c` (`init` at `11:09:43 WIB`, created `32 seconds` before `agy` started) plus **`7` agent-authored slice commits** (`3e3062d` `S1` through `732311e` `S7`). Per `tests/audit-runs.test.ts` (`countNonInitCommits`), `commits` records `7` while `commitLog` preserves all `8` commits.

ExUnit & Credo Verification (`39/39` in `113.0s`, `0` Credo Issues): Matches both the manual note (`Finished in 113.0 seconds (31.8s async, 81.2s sync) — 39 passed`) and in-session `task-354.log` (`112.8s: 31.9s async, 80.8s sync — 39 passed`). Full-suite runtime was `113s` because `4` CLI integration files (`paced_loop_test.exs`, `outcomes_test.exs`, `timing_test.exs`, `ctrl_c_test.exs` — `14` tests) ran sequentially with `async: false` (`81.2s sync`). notesDetails.title: 7.00s/Turn Inference Speed, 6 Transient 503 Capacity Retries (Latched result.status ERROR) & 11 manage_task List Checks
bullets: Why `events.jsonl` Ended with `result.status: "ERROR"` Despite Completing All Slices: Upstream server capacity experienced `6` transient `UNAVAILABLE (code 503): No capacity available for model gemini-4-hydrogen-high` errors across `3` clusters (`Step 41` at `11:13:35 WIB`, `Steps 124–127` attempts `1–4` at `11:18:51–11:19:25 WIB`, and `Step 331` at `11:39:26 WIB`, adding `~66s` of backoff). Antigravity CLI automatically retried and succeeded on every cluster through final Step `364`, but its terminal `result` summary latched `status: "ERROR"` from the earlier `error_message` step. Meanwhile, `20261119T041015Z.stderr.log` (`60 B` at `11:25:13 WIB`) logged a single benign notice (`root agent idle; waiting for 1 background task(s) to finish`) while waiting on `task-193`.

Fastest Per-Turn Inference (`7.00s/Turn`) & Multi-Tool Batching (`1.38` Tools/Turn): Total model inference across `144` turns was just **`1,008.2s`** (`49.8%` of wall-clock vs. `50.2%` tool execution & background `mix test` runs)—averaging **`7.00s/turn`** (`423` thinking tokens/turn), **`48%` faster per turn** than `gemini-4-neon` (`13.43s/turn`) and **`62%` faster** than `gemini-4-argon` (`18.6s/turn`). `50` of `144` turns (`34.7%`) batched `2–6` parallel tool calls (peaking at `6` file writes/edits in `S7` Step `335`). Across `16` backgrounded `run_command` tasks (`WaitMsBeforeAsync: 10000`), the agent issued `11` quick `manage_task` `list` checks before yielding to reactive `system_message` wakeups.

notesDetails.title: Mint HTTP/1.1 Streaming Client + SIGUSR2/+Bi Escript Wrapper Passed All Post-Boot PTY Ctrl-C Probes (~250 ms Cold-Boot SIGUSR2 Window)
bullets: Mint Streaming Client & OTP 28 `SIGUSR2` Wrapper: Like `gemini-4-neon`, `gemini-4-hydrogen` verified `~/.hex/packages/hexpm` offline availability during `Preparation`, added `{:mint, "~> 1.11"}` and `{:credo, "~> 1.7"}` to `mix.exs`, and built `CapyBench.HTTP` over `Mint.HTTP.connect/4` + `Mint.HTTP.stream/2` with strict `:verify_peer`, `SSL_CERT_FILE` / `:public_key.cacerts_get/0`, non-resetting `2,000 ms` monotonic deadlines, and single-connection keep-alive reuse without retries. For `S1`/`S7`, it built `cb.escript` with `emu_args: "-noinput +Bi"` and wrapped it in `./cb` trapping `INT` → `kill -USR2 "$child"` toward `CapyBench.SignalHandler` (`:erl_signal_server`).

Holdout Foreground PTY `Ctrl-C` Audit: Live PTY probes against `./cb` passed 100% once BEAM completed startup (`>= 300 ms`): `550 ms` while pacing (`exit 130`, `Started: 3, HTTP responses: 3`, empty `stderr`), `500 ms` during an `800 ms` slow request (`exit 130` at `0.83s`, `Started: 1, HTTP responses: 1`), `500 ms` during a `3,000 ms` stalled request (`exit 130` at `2.00s`, `Started: 1, Transport failures: 1`, diagnostic on `stderr`), and `650 ms` against live `https://rizafahmi.com` (`exit 130`, `Started: 1, HTTP responses: 1`), matching in-session `task-358.log`. Because `./cb` spawns `"$escript" "$@" &` without `( trap '' USR2; exec ... )` or a readiness file, `\x03` during the first `~250 ms` of cold VM boot exits `159` (`User defined signal 2: 31`) before `CapyBench.CLI.main/1` installs `SignalHandler`.

notesDetails.title: Fastest Gemini 4 Run on Antigravity CLI (34m vs. 44m Neon, 61m Argon & 88m Carbon) at $3.42 ($1.50/$0.075/$7.50 Rates, $20.70 Saved via Cache)
bullets: 99.0% File-Tool Precision & Decomposition of All 22 Tool Errors: `66/66` `edit_file` and `17/17` `read_file` calls succeeded on the first try; the lone file-tool error was `Step 51` (`write_file` on pre-existing `test/test_helper.exs` without `Overwrite=true`, fixed immediately via `edit_file` at `Step 52`). The `21` non-zero `run_command` exits comprised `15` deliberate red-phase TDD `mix test` runs (`S1` Steps `47`, `58`; `S2` Steps `81`, `89`, `95`, `101`, `107`; `S3` Steps `143`, `154`, `162`; `S4` Steps `205`, `215`; `S6` Steps `289`, `295`; `S7` Step `334`), `2` `mix credo --strict` nesting-depth refactors (`S3` Step `188`, `S6` Step `310`), `2` `S4` `http_get_test.exs` 5s-loop/selective-receive adjustments (`Steps 222, 232`), `1` `S3` compile syntax fix (`Step 148`), and `1` disposable `S3` `mix run` TLS check before setting `MIX_ENV=test` (`Step 164`).

Unit Economics & Prefix Cache Behavior (`94.22%` Hit Rate, 5 Post-Init Cache Resets): Priced at `$1.50/1M` input, `$0.075/1M` implicit cached input (`95%` off), and `$7.50/1M` output, the `15,548,035` tokens (`891,683` uncached = `$1.3375`, `14,523,312` cached = `$1.0892`, `133,040` output incl. `60,904` thinking = `$0.9978`) cost **`$3.42`** (`$3.4246` in 2026; `$6.85` under 2027 2x comparison rates), saving **`$20.70` (`85.8%`)** vs. `$24.12` uncached. Five post-Step-1 turns had `cache_read_tokens: 0` (`Steps 23, 75, 77, 128` right after the 4x `503` retry cluster, and `Step 157`), adding `~293k` uncached tokens (`~$0.42`).

Gemini 4 Quartet on Antigravity CLI (`hydrogen` vs. `neon`, `argon` & `carbon`): Across all four Gemini 4 High-effort runs on `antigravity cli` (all `7/7`), `gemini-4-hydrogen` is the fastest at **`34m`** (`23%` faster than `neon`'s `44m`, `44%` faster than `argon`'s `61m`, and `61%` faster than `carbon`'s `88m`) and second lowest in billed cost at **`$3.42`** (within `$0.05` of `argon`'s `$3.37`, `7%` below `neon`'s `$3.69`, and `52%` below `carbon`'s `$7.16`).
